start_api_server_adapter: start the OpenAI-compatible API server on a configurable host and port with aiohttp
build_response_store: build a SQLite-backed LRU store for OpenAI Responses API state with persistence across restarts
normalize_chat_content: normalize OpenAI chat message content arrays into a single plain text string with depth and size limits
normalize_multimodal_content: validate and normalize multimodal content supporting text and image_url parts for the API server
check_api_server_requirements: check if the API server dependencies such as aiohttp are available for the platform
